notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
Fixed the following:

- The Nest puzzle has been slightly reworked to be less frustrating and more understandable.

notes.title: Minor patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Fixed the following:

- Fixed the syntonization puzzle sound bug where no sounds where displayed.
- Added mouse interaction for dialogues

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
The patch has fixed the following problems:
- The audio levels have been adjusted.
- An audio issue where some sounds were not affected by the audio settings has been fixed.
- The incorrect language in Ending 3 has been fixed.
- A problem in the main menu has been fixed.
- A pause issue with the mouse in the Twilight Islands has been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where a choice did not work during the final boss fight.
- Fixed the camera movement icon not appearing in the Plain of Ashes and Liko's Cave.
- Corrected some dialogues.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Minor Fixes:
- Adjusted the movement of the next puzzle (fixed some hitboxes and modified the behavior).
- Fixed a dialogue in Second Return.
- Fixed a collider where the player could get stuck in the Twilight Islands.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Fixed issues:
- Added dialogues to the Plains of Ashes to make the puzzle more understandable.
- Fixed an issue in Liko's Cave where objects and the three Minions were not following the player over long distances.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1.1
notes.notes:
The following problems have been fixed or addressed:

- Fixed a hole in the ground in the Twilight Islands.
- Added some VFX to the last spot in the Nexus to help players understand where to go.
- Fixed a camera glitch in the three versions of Soul Island.
- Fixed a camera issue in the last part of the Plains of Ashes (may still have some bugs).
- Fixed a controller issue during the final boss.
- Adjusted hitboxes for several objects.
- Corrected some dialogues in the game.
- Fixed the fading screen to avoid getting stuck while using the pause button.
- Reduced the speed of the shadow souls.
- Increased the time before the invisible seagull disappears.
- Fixed some interactions.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Fixed the following bugs:

- Missing line in Navenkan.
- Fixed the Shisa puzzle.
- Adjusted the distance of the Pamun from the player and fixed the NPC movement.
- Added more NPCs to Twilight Island.
- Fixed animator issue with 1 Pamun.
- Fixed camera in Liko's cave.
- Fixed issue with last island dialogue not starting correctly.
- Fixed final boss missing line.
- Added an Easter egg.

notes.title: Patch note 1.1 of december 30
notes.notes:
Fixing Patch 1.1
The following bugs have been addressed:

-Fixed a bug where the kid in the tutorial was not interactable after the first fog.
-Fixed a bug where dialogues on Souls Island displayed the wrong character.
-Fixed a dialogue in Navenkan.
-Fixed the final dialogue of Twilight Islands.
-Fixed an issue where Nest choices directed the player to the opposite scene of what was expected.
-Fixed a bug where Resonance was disabled after capturing the fish in Liko's Cave.
-Fixed numerous typos in dialogues and more.
